entities.name: Alva M. Lumpkin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alva Moore Lumpkin was a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of South Carolina and the United States District Court for the Western District of South Carolina and was a United States senator from South Carolina.
